title: Assign, claim and release a node, and add or remove a contributor, from the dashboard
name: panel-owner
description: `assign`, `claim`, `release`, `contributors_add` and `contributors_remove` all have routes and no UI, so the team half of the product (MUST #11, #18) is command-line only. Panel: who is assigned and who holds the claim, with assign, claim and release; the chain claim (ADR 0050) where the server supports it. A contributors list — on the distribution screen or its own — with add and remove. The 409 on a stale claim is shown, not swallowed. Delete these five from KNOWN_GAPS.
